usage: mpm clean [-h] [--orphans] [--purge] [--purge-all] [mpmenv_path]

Execute the full MPM clean lifecycle.

If any dependency set MPM_SOURCE_<alias>_MARKETPLACE=true, runs
the uninstall script and removes the marketplace directory. Then
removes .packages/ and .mpm-data/ directories and prunes the
content-addressed entries from the shared MPM_HOME store.

With --orphans, before the normal teardown mpm also unregisters
any mpm-owned marketplaces recorded in .mpm.lock that are no
longer referenced by .mpm (pruning them from ~/.claude).

With --purge, mpm also deletes this project's .mpm and
.mpm.lock files. With --purge-all, it additionally removes the
shared MPM_HOME store directory (default ~/.mpm-home); this
runs even when no .mpm project is present.

positional arguments:
  mpmenv_path  Path to the .mpm configuration file (default: auto-discover
               from current directory)

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --orphans    Also unregister mpm-owned marketplaces no longer referenced by
               .mpm/.mpm.lock (prunes them from ~/.claude).
  --purge      Also delete this project's .mpm and .mpm.lock files after the
               normal teardown (full removal of the project's mpm config).
  --purge-all  Everything --purge does, and also remove the shared mpm home
               store directory (MPM_HOME, default ~/.mpm-home) used by all
               projects. Runs even when no .mpm project is present (removes
               only the shared store).

Example:
  mpm clean             # auto-discovers .mpm
  mpm clean .mpm      # explicit path
  mpm clean --orphans   # also unregister orphaned marketplaces
  mpm clean --purge     # also delete .mpm and .mpm.lock
  mpm clean --purge-all # also remove the MPM_HOME store dir
